items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: there was a, a promoter around here whose name was Sherman, Sherman Cook I think was his name.

ctx.x: The Secret Nine. What was it?

Was it, uh, uh, there was a, a promoter around here whose name was Sherman, Sherman Cook I think was his name. And, uh, he got together with Cephas to do a publicity thing and, uh, and set up a baseball team, you know, just like it shows in the photographs. Right. So they got, uh, sponsored, uh, to, uh, provide uniforms and everything. Uh-huh. And they played a few games and, uh, got their picture taken with Louie and that was it.

So in other words, they went, they went to Louie and said, look, we've got this team. Yeah. If you pay for the uniforms, you can, you can have, you can have your own baseball team that says Armstrong's Secret Nine. Sure. Yeah. Right. So that was, that was, it was one year? It was one, one season? That's all, one season.
